Sasha: Heads up — Meridian Labs renewal hits next Tue. POC went well but CS is asking for uplift + a discount. Need quick alignment on commit and any rate-card exception.
Priya (AM): Got it. What numbers are they requesting?
Omar (CS): POC metrics: 95th p50 latency at 120ms, avg qps steady. They consumed ~18M tokens in the trial. Business asks: move from pay-as-you-go to a committed plan and pull forward 15% off list for year 1. Also asked for a short security scoping call (data residency questions).
Sasha: Yep — they want $150k commit for yr1 (vs current projected $120k). Asking for 15% off list pricing and 6 months free burst credits.
Miguel (Deal Desk): Quick checklist: ARR impact, gross discount %, and any special legal terms. 15% is material — will need Director approval. Upload deal stub to Deal Desk form and tag me.
Sasha: Stub attached in drive: link=https://redwood.app/drive/meridian-renewal-1806 (internal)
Jenna (Legal): Heads-up on two items Meridian flagged in their SQA: (1) audit access window (they want quarterly), (2) indemnity carveouts for third-party data. Both are non-standard. We can likely accept (1) with a limited scope, (2) needs review by Legal Ops.
sec-bot: Security questionnaire #MQ-472 created and assigned to Meridian. Link: https://security.redwood/qs/MQ-472
Priya (AM): If Legal wants carveouts, that will affect approval cadence. Miguel — can you quantify approval path and ETA if we accept 10% vs 15%?
Miguel (Deal Desk): 10% -> Director approval (24-48h). 15% -> VP sign-off + Finance review (3-5 business days). Any special SLAs or data residency demands will add time.
Omar (CS): Also, they asked for private deployment option (VPC) as part of renewals Q&A. That is a upsell but will require infra lead + SSO/KMS details.
Sasha: Realistic counterproposal: 10% off year1, $130k commit, 3 months of burst credits, and schedule a security scoping call. If they sign in current quarter, we can grandfather current latency SLOs. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (AM): That sounds reasonable. Keeps CFO happy while showing flexibility. I'll prep the commercial terms and call cadence.
Jenna (Legal): OK on the counter. I'll prepare a minimal audit clause and flag indemnity language that needs Legal Ops review. Can we get Meridian to limit audit to production logs related to their tenant only?
Sasha: Yes, will request that on the call.
Miguel (Deal Desk): Please add the following into the Deal Desk form: proposed discount 10%, list price reference (2026-ratecard-v2), commit $130k YR1, requested start 2026-07-01, upsell: VPC evaluation (TBD). I'll queue Director approval once stub is complete.
Sasha: Done — form link uploaded. Miguel, ping me when queued.
Miguel (Deal Desk): Ping received. Queued for Director review. ETA 36h.
Omar (CS): I'll join the security scoping call and can cover KMS/SSO/ingress rules. Can we aim for Wed 09:00 PT?
Priya (AM): Wed 09:00 PT works. I'll send invite to Meridian and include Meridian's security contact.
Sasha: Quick note for sales ops — if Meridian signs >$125k commit, we need to confirm billing cadence with Finance (annual upfront vs quarterly commit). Priya, which do they prefer?
Priya (AM): CFO asked for annual upfront but said they'd accept quarterly if needed for cashflow. I'll clarify on Wed call.
Jenna (Legal): Also request Meridian complete the security questionnaire before the scoping call so we avoid rework. sec-bot, can you mark MQ-472 as required pre-call?
sec-bot: MQ-472 status: requires customer completion before scoping call. Reminder scheduled 48h before meeting.
Sasha: Great. Thanks everyone — will run the Wed call, push the counter, and update this thread after the meeting. :thumbsup:
Priya (AM): Thanks — will prepare the commercial term sheet and attach to the deal form.
Miguel (Deal Desk): Director approval pending. If they push for the 15% again, escalate to me immediately.
Omar (CS): I'll draft a one-page VPC scoping checklist to share on the call.
Sasha: End of thread for now — expect updates post-call. :rocket:
